template.description: Trace a demand shock through system capacity, physical or technical constraints, value migration, localization gaps, and evidence-backed company-mapping preparation.

steps.title: Define demand shock
steps.purpose: State the measurable demand change, its time horizon, and the actor creating it.
quality_gates: A reviewed demand claim must cite at least one accepted source.

steps.title: Set system boundary
steps.purpose: Define where the system starts and ends so that missing links and double counting are visible.
quality_gates: Every included node must sit inside the declared system boundary.

steps.title: Locate system bottleneck
steps.purpose: Identify the capacity, performance, permitting, integration, or qualification constraint that limits system output.
quality_gates: A bottleneck must have a measurable constraint or remain needs_evidence.

steps.title: Map chain nodes
steps.purpose: Break the system into upstream enablers, core constraints, integration layers, and downstream applications.
quality_gates: Every non-root node must have a valid parent and a supported node type.

steps.title: Assess supply constraints
steps.purpose: Separate structural scarcity, capacity limits, certification cycles, and ordinary cyclical tightness.
quality_gates: Supply tightness cannot be inferred from demand growth alone.

steps.title: Assess value migration
steps.purpose: Determine whether value moves through BOM share, ASP, margin, scarcity, integration control, certification, capacity, or technology barriers.
quality_gates: Every value-capture conclusion must name its value basis and evidence IDs.

steps.title: Assess localization and evidence gaps
steps.purpose: Measure import dependence, domestic capability, customer verification, and unresolved evidence gaps at node level.
quality_gates: Localization claims require product-level evidence and cannot rely on company-name mentions.

steps.title: Prepare company mapping queue
steps.purpose: Create a later review queue linking companies to specific nodes without treating theme membership as investment evidence.
quality_gates: Company mapping remains optional and blocked until node relationship and evidence are explicit.

node_archetypes.label: Demand Driver
node_archetypes.purpose: The end demand or workload creating pressure on the system.

node_archetypes.label: System Constraint
node_archetypes.purpose: The system-level capacity or performance boundary.

node_archetypes.label: Upstream Enabler
node_archetypes.purpose: Materials, equipment, or infrastructure needed before the bottleneck can expand.

node_archetypes.label: Core Bottleneck
node_archetypes.purpose: The component, subsystem, equipment, or software function that directly limits output.

node_archetypes.label: Integration Layer
node_archetypes.purpose: The layer coordinating multiple constrained components into a working system.

node_archetypes.label: Substitution Path
node_archetypes.purpose: Alternative technology or domestic product route that can relieve the bottleneck.

node_archetypes.label: Downstream Application
node_archetypes.purpose: The application or customer segment receiving expanded system output.
